task.description: Find defects in one pull request and return only the findings that survive an independent attempt to disprove them. Each finding is a short claim that can be checked against the code: a file, a line, a verbatim quote and a failure scenario.
closure_criteria: validation: every published finding quotes code that exists at its file and line (re-checked by reviewkit.review.findings before anything is posted)
controls: on merged, stable pull requests in the eval set the review publishes no Important finding
delivery: the result validates against output-schema.json, every planned lens is listed as completed, and every candidate is either confirmed or rejected with a reason
repeat: recall on the eval set's known bugs holds across 3 runs, compared with the single-finder baseline at the same level of effort

baseline.metric: recall of known bugs on the review eval fixture (docs/EVALS.md), single finder plus verifier (review.level quick)

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Lead protocol: load the prepared context, dispatch one finder per lens, send every candidate to the verifier, assemble the result

skills.name: bug-finding
skills.description: Finder playbook: lenses, method, evidence rules and candidate format

skills.name: finding-verification
skills.description: Judge rubric: premise-by-premise checks, verdict grounds, severity calibration, status of earlier findings

agents.instructions: Dispatch the planned lenses, pass candidates verbatim to the verifier, assemble the confirmed findings without changing location, severity or meaning.
Find defects through one assigned lens (correctness, contracts, cross-file); return candidates with a verbatim quote and a failure scenario.
Same agent definition as bug-finder, run on a second model for the tests-evidence lens so the finders' blind spots differ.
Try to disprove each candidate against the code; give every candidate a verdict with a reason.

tasks.start_condition: review-context.json exists with the diff, the head tree, the trusted rules and the lens list
tasks.done_criterion: one JSON object per lens with status and a candidates list, each candidate carrying path, line and a verbatim quote

tasks.start_condition: review-context.json exists with the diff, the head tree, the trusted rules and the lens list
tasks.done_criterion: one JSON object for the tests-evidence lens with status and a candidates list, each candidate carrying path, line and a verbatim quote

tasks.start_condition: every planned finder returned JSON or was recorded as not completed
tasks.done_criterion: a verdicts list with one entry per candidate index and a prior list with one entry per earlier finding id
structured output that validates against output-schema.json with coverage.lenses_completed filled in
